verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents user-defined automation building blocks: Agent Flows and 'custom agent workflows', plus a built-in automatic meeting transcription and summary that runs when a call ends. Nothing shows users can attach their own rules to events so actions fire on their own; the Agent Flows evidence is only a page title, so how flows are triggered is undocumented. missing for 10: user-defined event triggers or rules, documentation of trigger types (schedules, webhooks, document or chat events), detail on Agent Flow execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.
